description: This file defines a benchmark test class 'StartupMacrobenchmark' for measuring app startup performance and frame timing using AndroidX Benchmark library. It contains test methods for cold startup and startup+scroll performance, utilizing macros and UI Automator.

classes.name: StartupMacrobenchmark
classes.description: JUnit test class for benchmarking app startup time and frame performance on Android devices.

methods.name: coldStartup
methods.description: Runs a benchmark measuring cold startup time with specific metrics and configurations.

methods.name: startupAndScrollFrameTiming
methods.description: Runs a benchmark measuring startup and scroll performance by simulating user scrolls.

methods.name: runBenchmarkOrSkip
methods.description: Helper function that executes a block of code, skipping on known device issues.
